model.code:
; ============================================================ ; STOCHASTIC TUMOR-NORMAL CELL INTERACTION MODEL ; Shared metabolic microenvironment ; ============================================================
breed [tumor-cells tumor-cell] breed [normal-cells normal-cell] breed [stress-signals stress-signal]
; ============================================================ ; 1. GLOBAL VARIABLES ; ============================================================
globals [
mean-glucose mean-lactate mean-oxygen
total-signal-events tumor-signal-events normal-signal-events
tumor-hatching-time normal-hatching-time
signal-decay-min signal-decay-max
tumor-capacity normal-capacity signal-capacity
]
; ============================================================ ; 2. PATCH VARIABLES ; ============================================================
patches-own [
region
oxygen-mmHg glucose-mM lactate-mM
old-glucose old-lactate
]
; ============================================================ ; 3. TUMOR CELL VARIABLES ; ============================================================
tumor-cells-own [
metabolic-state
stress-exposure
signal-events
cell-age
hatching-time
division-ready?
]
; ============================================================ ; 4. NORMAL CELL VARIABLES ; ============================================================
normal-cells-own [
metabolic-state
stress-exposure
signal-events
cell-age
hatching-time
division-ready?
]
; ============================================================ ; 5. STRESS SIGNAL VARIABLES ; ============================================================
stress-signals-own [
signal-age
signal-lifetime
source-type
]
; ============================================================ ; 6. SETUP ; ============================================================
to setup
clear-all
; Cell-cycle delays (ticks)
set tumor-hatching-time 20 set normal-hatching-time 30
; Individual molecular lifetimes (ticks)
set signal-decay-min 10 set signal-decay-max 40
; Population limits
set tumor-capacity 400 set normal-capacity 300 set signal-capacity 500
; Interaction counters
set total-signal-events 0 set tumor-signal-events 0 set normal-signal-events 0
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; ENVIRONMENT CREATION ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask patches [
ifelse distancexy 0 0 < 7 [
set region "hypoxic" set oxygen-mmHg Hypoxic-Core-Oxygen set pcolor 137
][
set region "normoxic" set oxygen-mmHg Normoxic-Oxygen set pcolor 57
]
set glucose-mM Initial-Glucose-mM
set lactate-mM 2
set old-glucose glucose-mM set old-lactate lactate-mM
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; INITIAL TUMOR CELLS ; ----------------------------------------------------------
create-tumor-cells Initial-Tumor-Cells [
set shape "circle" set size 1.5 set color red
move-to one-of patches
set stress-exposure 0 set signal-events 0
set hatching-time tumor-hatching-time
set cell-age random (hatching-time + 1)
set division-ready? (cell-age >= hatching-time)
update-tumor-state
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; INITIAL NORMAL CELLS ; ----------------------------------------------------------
create-normal-cells Initial-Normal-Cells [
set shape "circle" set size 1.2 set color blue
move-to one-of patches
set stress-exposure 0 set signal-events 0
set hatching-time normal-hatching-time
set cell-age random (hatching-time + 1)
set division-ready? (cell-age >= hatching-time)
update-normal-state
]
; Initial measurements
set mean-glucose mean [glucose-mM] of patches set mean-lactate mean [lactate-mM] of patches set mean-oxygen mean [oxygen-mmHg] of patches
configure-model-plots
reset-ticks
refresh-model-plots
end
; ============================================================ ; 7. MAIN SIMULATION ; ============================================================
to go
if not any? tumor-cells and not any? normal-cells [ stop ]
update-oxygen
move-cells
move-signals
update-cell-aging
cellular-signalling
cellular-metabolism
update-environment
update-tumor-population
update-normal-population
release-stress-signals
; Environmental measurements
set mean-glucose mean [glucose-mM] of patches
set mean-lactate mean [lactate-mM] of patches
set mean-oxygen mean [oxygen-mmHg] of patches
tick
refresh-model-plots
end
; ============================================================ ; 8. OXYGEN ENVIRONMENT ; ============================================================
to update-oxygen
ask patches [
ifelse region = "hypoxic" [
set oxygen-mmHg max list 0 (Hypoxic-Core-Oxygen + random-float 2 - 1)
set pcolor 137
][
set oxygen-mmHg max list 0 (Normoxic-Oxygen + random-float 2 - 1)
set pcolor 57
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 9. RANDOM CELL MOVEMENT ; ============================================================
to move-cells
ask tumor-cells [
rt random 360 fd 0.35
]
ask normal-cells [
rt random 360 fd 0.25
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 10. TUMOR METABOLIC STATE ; ============================================================
to update-tumor-state
ifelse [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here < 10 [
set metabolic-state "hypoxic"
set color red set size 1.5
][
set metabolic-state "normoxic"
set color orange set size 1.3
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 11. NORMAL METABOLIC STATE ; ============================================================
to update-normal-state
ifelse [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here < 10 [
set metabolic-state "hypoxic"
set color blue set size 1.2
][
set metabolic-state "normoxic"
set color sky set size 1.0
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 12. CELL-CYCLE AGING AND HATCHING ; ============================================================
to update-cell-aging
ask tumor-cells [
set cell-age cell-age + 1
if cell-age >= hatching-time [
set division-ready? true
]
]
ask normal-cells [
set cell-age cell-age + 1
if cell-age >= hatching-time [
set division-ready? true
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 13. RANDOM MOLECULAR MOVEMENT AND DECAY ; ============================================================
to move-signals
ask stress-signals [
rt random 360
fd 0.45
set signal-age signal-age + 1
; Stochastic decay
if random-float 1 < 0.03 [
die
]
; Maximum molecular lifetime
if signal-age >= signal-lifetime [
die
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 14. DIFFERENTIAL CELLULAR SIGNALLING ; ============================================================
to cellular-signalling
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; TUMOR CELL RESPONSE ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask tumor-cells [
let encountered one-of stress-signals in-radius 1.2
if encountered != nobody [
; Probability of interaction
if random-float 1 < 0.35 [
ask encountered [ die ]
; Tumor response to extracellular signal
set stress-exposure stress-exposure + 0.7
set signal-events signal-events + 1
set total-signal-events total-signal-events + 1
set tumor-signal-events tumor-signal-events + 1
]
]
; Stress recovery
set stress-exposure max list 0 (stress-exposure - 0.03)
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; NORMAL CELL RESPONSE ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask normal-cells [
let encountered one-of stress-signals in-radius 1.2
if encountered != nobody [
; Normal cells have a different response probability
if random-float 1 < 0.55 [
ask encountered [ die ]
set stress-exposure stress-exposure + 1
set signal-events signal-events + 1
set total-signal-events total-signal-events + 1
set normal-signal-events normal-signal-events + 1
]
]
; Stress recovery
set stress-exposure max list 0 (stress-exposure - 0.06)
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 15. SHARED GLUCOSE POOL AND CELL METABOLISM ; ============================================================
to cellular-metabolism
; Both populations consume glucose from the same patch. ; Tumor and normal cells have different uptake assumptions.
ask tumor-cells [
update-tumor-state
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-patch patch-here
let uptake 0.002
let lactate-release 0.003
; Tumor metabolic response under hypoxia
if local-oxygen < 10 [
set uptake 0.003
set lactate-release 0.006
]
ask local-patch [
set glucose-mM max list 0 (glucose-mM - uptake)
set lactate-mM lactate-mM + lactate-release
]
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; NORMAL CELL METABOLISM ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask normal-cells [
update-normal-state
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-patch patch-here
let uptake 0.0015
let lactate-release 0.0005
; Normal-cell metabolic response under hypoxia
if local-oxygen < 10 [
set uptake 0.001
set lactate-release 0.001
]
ask local-patch [
set glucose-mM max list 0 (glucose-mM - uptake)
set lactate-mM lactate-mM + lactate-release
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 16. GLUCOSE REPLENISHMENT AND DIFFUSION ; ============================================================
to update-environment
; Save old concentrations for synchronous diffusion
ask patches [
set old-glucose glucose-mM
set old-lactate lactate-mM
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; GLUCOSE SUPPLY ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask patches [
ifelse region = "normoxic" [
; Glucose approaches the baseline supply concentration
set glucose-mM glucose-mM + (0.004 * (Initial-Glucose-mM - glucose-mM))
][
; Reduced glucose replenishment in hypoxic core
set glucose-mM glucose-mM + (0.001 * (Initial-Glucose-mM - glucose-mM))
]
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; GLUCOSE DIFFUSION ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask patches [
let nearby-glucose mean [old-glucose] of neighbors
set glucose-mM max list 0 (glucose-mM + 0.08 * (nearby-glucose - old-glucose))
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; LACTATE DIFFUSION ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask patches [
let nearby-lactate mean [old-lactate] of neighbors
set lactate-mM max list 0 (old-lactate + 0.08 * (nearby-lactate - old-lactate))
; Lactate clearance
set lactate-mM max list 0 (lactate-mM * 0.98)
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 17. STOCHASTIC SIGNAL RELEASE ; ============================================================
to release-stress-signals
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; TUMOR-DERIVED SIGNALS ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask tumor-cells [
let release-probability 0.025
if metabolic-state = "hypoxic" [
set release-probability 0.08
]
if stress-exposure > 2 [
set release-probability release-probability + 0.04
]
if random-float 1 < release-probability [
if count stress-signals < signal-capacity [
hatch-stress-signals 1 [
set shape "circle"
set color violet
set size 0.45
set signal-age 0
set signal-lifetime (signal-decay-min + random (signal-decay-max - signal-decay-min + 1))
set source-type "tumor"
rt random 360
fd 0.5
]
]
]
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; NORMAL-CELL-DERIVED SIGNALS ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask normal-cells [
let release-probability 0.005
if metabolic-state = "hypoxic" [
set release-probability 0.035
]
if stress-exposure > 2 [
set release-probability release-probability + 0.025
]
if random-float 1 < release-probability [
if count stress-signals < signal-capacity [
hatch-stress-signals 1 [
set shape "circle"
set color violet
set size 0.45
set signal-age 0
set signal-lifetime (signal-decay-min + random (signal-decay-max - signal-decay-min + 1))
set source-type "normal"
rt random 360
fd 0.5
]
]
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 18. TUMOR CELL SURVIVAL AND PROLIFERATION ; ============================================================
to update-tumor-population
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; TUMOR CELL DEATH ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask tumor-cells [
update-tumor-state
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-glucose [glucose-mM] of patch-here
let local-lactate [lactate-mM] of patch-here
let death-probability 0.0015
if local-oxygen < 10 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.003
]
if local-glucose < 0.5 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.015
]
if local-lactate > 15 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.004
]
set death-probability death-probability + min list 0.08 (stress-exposure * 0.003)
if random-float 1 < death-probability [
die
]
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; TUMOR CELL DIVISION ; ----------------------------------------------------------
if count tumor-cells < tumor-capacity [
ask tumor-cells [
if count tumor-cells < tumor-capacity [
if division-ready? [
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-glucose [glucose-mM] of patch-here
let local-lactate [lactate-mM] of patch-here
let division-probability 0.003
if local-glucose > 1 [
set division-probability division-probability + 0.002
]
if local-oxygen < 10 [
set division-probability division-probability * 0.65
]
if local-glucose < 0.5 [
set division-probability division-probability * 0.2
]
if local-lactate > 15 [
set division-probability division-probability * 0.8
]
set division-probability division-probability * (1 - min list 0.5 (stress-exposure * 0.03))
if count tumor-cells-on patch-here < 4 [
if random-float 1 < division-probability [
; Reset parent cell cycle
set cell-age 0
set division-ready? false
; Daughter tumor cell
hatch 1 [
set cell-age 0
set hatching-time tumor-hatching-time
set division-ready? false
set stress-exposure 0
set signal-events 0
rt random 360
fd 0.5
update-tumor-state
]
]
]
]
]
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 19. NORMAL CELL SURVIVAL AND PROLIFERATION ; ============================================================
to update-normal-population
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; NORMAL CELL DEATH ; ----------------------------------------------------------
ask normal-cells [
update-normal-state
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-glucose [glucose-mM] of patch-here
let local-lactate [lactate-mM] of patch-here
let death-probability 0.001
if local-oxygen < 10 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.012
]
if local-glucose < 0.5 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.015
]
if local-lactate > 10 [
set death-probability death-probability + 0.008
]
set death-probability death-probability + min list 0.15 (stress-exposure * 0.008)
if random-float 1 < death-probability [
die
]
]
; ---------------------------------------------------------- ; NORMAL CELL DIVISION ; ----------------------------------------------------------
if count normal-cells < normal-capacity [
ask normal-cells [
if count normal-cells < normal-capacity [
if division-ready? [
let local-oxygen [oxygen-mmHg] of patch-here
let local-glucose [glucose-mM] of patch-here
let local-lactate [lactate-mM] of patch-here
let division-probability 0.002
if local-oxygen >= 10 [
set division-probability division-probability + 0.003
]
if local-glucose < 0.5 [
set division-probability division-probability * 0.2
]
if local-lactate > 10 [
set division-probability division-probability * 0.4
]
set division-probability division-probability * (1 - min list 0.7 (stress-exposure * 0.05))
if count normal-cells-on patch-here < 4 [
if random-float 1 < division-probability [
; Reset parent cell cycle
set cell-age 0
set division-ready? false
; Daughter normal cell
hatch 1 [
set cell-age 0
set hatching-time normal-hatching-time
set division-ready? false
set stress-exposure 0
set signal-events 0
rt random 360
fd 0.5
update-normal-state
]
]
]
]
]
]
]
end
; ============================================================ ; 20. GRAPH INITIALIZATION ; ============================================================
to configure-model-plots
; GRAPH 1: CELL POPULATION
set-current-plot "Cell Population Comparison"
clear-plot
create-temporary-plot-pen "Tumor cells"
set-plot-pen-color red
create-temporary-plot-pen "Normal cells"
set-plot-pen-color blue
; GRAPH 2: GLUCOSE
set-current-plot "Mean Glucose (mM)"
clear-plot
create-temporary-plot-pen "Glucose"
set-plot-pen-color green
; GRAPH 3: LACTATE
set-current-plot "Mean Lactate (mM)"
clear-plot
create-temporary-plot-pen "Lactate"
set-plot-pen-color violet
; GRAPH 4: STRESS RESPONSE
set-current-plot "Cell Stress Comparison"
clear-plot
create-temporary-plot-pen "Tumor stress"
set-plot-pen-color red
create-temporary-plot-pen "Normal stress"
set-plot-pen-color blue
end
; ============================================================ ; 21. GRAPH UPDATES ; ============================================================
to refresh-model-plots
; GRAPH 1: CELL POPULATION
set-current-plot "Cell Population Comparison"
set-current-plot-pen "Tumor cells"
plot count tumor-cells
set-current-plot-pen "Normal cells"
plot count normal-cells
; GRAPH 2: GLUCOSE
set-current-plot "Mean Glucose (mM)"
set-current-plot-pen "Glucose"
plot mean-glucose
; GRAPH 3: LACTATE
set-current-plot "Mean Lactate (mM)"
set-current-plot-pen "Lactate"
plot mean-lactate
; GRAPH 4: STRESS COMPARISON
set-current-plot "Cell Stress Comparison"
set-current-plot-pen "Tumor stress"
plot mean-tumor-stress
set-current-plot-pen "Normal stress"
plot mean-normal-stress
end
; ============================================================ ; 22. MONITOR REPORTERS ; ============================================================
to-report tumor-hypoxic-count
report count tumor-cells with [ [region] of patch-here = "hypoxic" ]
end
to-report normal-hypoxic-count
report count normal-cells with [ [region] of patch-here = "hypoxic" ]
end
to-report tumor-normoxic-count
report count tumor-cells with [ [region] of patch-here = "normoxic" ]
end
to-report normal-normoxic-count
report count normal-cells with [ [region] of patch-here = "normoxic" ]
end
to-report mean-tumor-stress
ifelse any? tumor-cells [
report mean [stress-exposure] of tumor-cells
][
report 0
]
end
to-report mean-normal-stress
ifelse any? normal-cells [
report mean [stress-exposure] of normal-cells
][
report 0
]
end
to-report mean-tumor-signal-events
ifelse any? tumor-cells [
report mean [signal-events] of tumor-cells
][
report 0
]
end
to-report mean-normal-signal-events
ifelse any? normal-cells [
report mean [signal-events] of normal-cells
][
report 0
]
end
to-report active-stress-signals
report count stress-signals
end
to-report tumor-derived-signals
report count stress-signals with [ source-type = "tumor" ]
end
to-report normal-derived-signals
report count stress-signals with [ source-type = "normal" ]
end
